purpose: One switch for the shot-scope upgrade so every line opts in by episode and every earlier episode compiles byte-for-byte as before (no fingerprint change for submitted or in-flight tasks).

rules.per_shot_camera_serialization: Every shot of a multi-shot unit carries its own camera line (scale, height, side, motion family/direction, start framing, end framing, follow subject) into the final provider prompt; a LOCKED shot states a locked camera and never 'execute the move once'.
rules.entity_scoped_visibility: A partial-visibility clause (hands/paws/arm/legs only, face out of frame) is bound to one entity + one shot/beat + its time window and names that entity; it never applies to other entities, other shots, or entities whose visibility is missing. Missing visibility is never silently read as 'face forbidden'.
rules.submit_boundary_conflict_gate: Before any paid POST the final serialized request is checked: no entity is both a visible-mouth speaker and face/mouth-forbidden in the same window; no partial clause leaks beyond its declared entity/shot; a LOCKED shot carries no move instruction. A changed request needs a fresh check bound to its exact hash. Bound task_id recovery/poll/download is never blocked.
rules.loaded_module_audit: Each request records the path and sha256 of the renderer/gate modules actually loaded (including local overlays), so a local override cannot impersonate the repository version.

default.note: a line not listed keeps legacy behaviour until it is added here
